cards.audioText: Your call sign is ACA587, cruising level 10100m, squawk 3215, approaching DAPRO, make an initiate contact with Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航587，巡航高度10100米，应答机3215，接近DAPRO，和广州区调进行初次联系。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA587, maintaining 10100m, approaching DAPRO, squawk 3215.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航587，保持10100米，接近DAPRO，应答机3215。

cards.audioText: ACA587, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, maintain 10100m, report DAPRO.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，广州区调，雷达已识别，保持10100米，到DAPRO报告。

cards.audioText: There's moderate turbulence at 10100m, ask if there's any turbulence at 10700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 10100米处有中度颠簸，询问10700米处是否有颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Control, ACA587, we suffer moderate turbulence at 10100m. Confirm any turbulence reported at 10700m?
cards.referenceTextZh: 区调，加航587，我们在10100米遇到中度颠簸。证实10700米处有报告颠簸么？

cards.audioText: ACA587, no reported turbulence at 10700m.[Ask to climb to 10700m due to moderate turbulence.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，10700米处无颠簸报告。【由于中度颠簸，请求爬升10700米。】
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 10700m due moderate turbulence, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于中度颠簸，请求爬升10700米，加航587。

cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，上升保持10700米，2分钟到。
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持10700米，2分钟到，加航587。

cards.audioText: When you are at 10700m, left engine failed, make an urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在10700米时，左侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，请求右转航行，并下降6300米。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA587, left engine failure, request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，广州区调，加航587，左侧发动机失效，请求右转，下降6300米。

cards.audioText: ACA587, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，收到PANPAN，右转航向200，下降保持6300米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300m, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向200，下降保持6300米，加航587。

cards.audioText: Advise Guangzhou Control you want to divert to Wuhan airport, and track direct to WHA, and descend to low level.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉广州区调你想改航至武汉机场，直飞WHA，下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA587, request divert to Wuhan, request direct to WHA, descend to lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航587，请求改航至武汉，直飞WHA，下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: ACA587, turn left direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100m on QNH 1023.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，左转直飞WHA，下降保持修正海压2100米，修正海压1023。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100m QNH 1023, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞WHA，下降保持修正海压2100米，修正海压1023，加航587。

cards.audioText: The weather is deteriorating and is below landing minima, ask ATC for ILS approach runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 天气状况恶劣，低于着陆最低天气标准，向ATC请求盲降进近跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, ACA587, request ILS approach runway 36L due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，加航587，由于天气原因，请求盲降进近跑道36左。

cards.audioText: ACA587, runway 36L not available, runway in use 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，跑道36左不可用，使用跑道36右。

cards.audioText: Ask controller is there any restrictions.
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA587, confirm any restrictions?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航587，证实是否有其它限制？
收到，没有速度限制，加航587。

cards.audioText: You executed missed approach procedure and try to land on runway 36R. State this situation to Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 执行复飞程序，尝试降落在跑道36右。向塔台报告该情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA587, going around and we try to land runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航587，复飞，我们试降跑道36右。

cards.audioText: ACA587, Tower, climb and maintain 1200m, follow standard missed approach procedure, standby sequences.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，塔台，上升保持1200米，执行标准复飞程序，按顺序等待。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 1200m, standard missed approach procedure, standby sequences, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持1200米，执行标准复飞程序，按顺序等待，加航587。

cards.audioText: ACA587, runway 36R is available now, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，现在跑道36右可用，雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达引导，盲降跑道36右，加航587。

cards.audioText: You established on runway 36R, and ask Tower for runway braking action.
cards.audioTextZh: 建立盲降跑道36右，询问塔台该跑道的刹车效应。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, ACA587, established 36R, request braking action of 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，加航587，建立盲降跑道36右，请求跑道36右刹车效应。

cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，跑道36右刹车效应好。
